node.statement: Let 0 < lambda < 1/2 and let F=(f_ab) be a 4-by-4 stochastic idempotent with ||P_lambda-F||_{infinity->infinity}<lambda. The norm formula and row_1(P_lambda)=(1-lambda,0,lambda,0) from lem-prh-sharpness-family-arithmetic give |f_11-(1-lambda)|<lambda and |f_13-lambda|<lambda. Therefore f_11>1-2*lambda>0 and f_13>0.
